'''Strength enhancing system''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Armor accessory|enhancement]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The system would increase the wearer's overall strength, and allowed him to easily carry heavier loads for longer periods of time. Several models of system were available, all costing about 5500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; these included [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries's]] [["Brute" strength enhancer]], [[Atlas Corp]]'s [[Myomer strength enhancer system]] and [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[Xr5 Power Assist]].
